Report a bug

Tell us what happened and attach the diagnostics archive from the run that failed. The report form requires a .tar.gz file, your Quadra version, reproduction steps, expected behavior, renderer and window backend.

  1. Prepare crash or freeze diagnostics. For crashes, enable Settings → Environment → Diagnostics → Crash diagnostics and Allow freeze diagnostics before starting Roblox.
  2. Reproduce the problem. Note what you clicked or pressed and the error you saw. For HTTP 403, include which download failed and its URL if shown.
  3. Collect the matching archive. Choose Collect diagnostics in Quadra’s menu after the failure. For a freeze, collect while the game is still frozen. Keep the generated quadra-diagnostics-*.tar.gz compressed.
  4. Check the run, then attach it. Make sure the archive’s version and timestamps match this failure. A hardware-report JSON or a log from an older run will not contain the current crash details.

Reports and attachments are public on GitHub. Review the archive before uploading. Quadra redacts known sign-in secrets and join tickets; avoid adding cookies or unredacted join links yourself.

Continue to GitHub View existing reports

Sign in to GitHub to complete the form and upload the required archive (up to 25 MB). Screenshots and extra logs are optional. If you need help collecting the archive, ask on Discord.
